mainTopic: Three brothers, two married to sisters: when a נכרית becomes a צרה of an ערוה, the rule that 'forbidden once, forbidden forever', and רב נחמן against רב אשי on whether זיקה is real
overview: This amud has a run of משניות about three brothers. Two of them are married to two sisters, and the third is married to an unrelated woman (נכרית). In the first two משניות, יבום makes the נכרית a צרה of a sister who is forbidden to the last brother, so both women go free. If only מאמר was done, the נכרית does חליצה and not יבום. From the first משנה, רב נחמן learns that אין זיקה, even with one brother. The גמרא then asks why the second משנה is needed at all, since it follows by קל וחומר. It answers that the תנא changed his ruling, and a משנה does not move from its place. The next משנה teaches that a sister who was forbidden to a brother at one moment stays forbidden to him forever. רב then gives a general rule about the moment of falling, and the גמרא shows what that rule adds beyond two משניות. The last משנה shows when a צרה is permitted because the sister was divorced first. From it, רב אשי learns that יש זיקה, even with two brothers. He then answers רב נחמן's proof by saying the mention of מאמר is there to reject בית שמאי, and this answer continues on the next amud.

steps.title: First משנה: the brother married to the unrelated woman takes his sister-in-law
steps.stepSummary: A sister's husband dies, and the נכרית's husband does יבום with the widow and then dies. Both women go free from the last brother: one as his wife's sister, the other as her צרה. If he did only מאמר, the נכרית does חליצה and not יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: Three brothers: two are married to two sisters, and one is married to an unrelated woman. One of the sisters' husbands died. The brother with the unrelated woman took the widow in יבום and then died. The first woman goes free because she is the remaining brother's wife's sister, and the second goes free because she is her co-wife. If he only did מאמר with her and died, the unrelated woman does חליצה and not יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה lays out a case where the נכרית becomes a צרה (co-wife) of a woman who is forbidden to the last remaining brother.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once the brother married the widowed sister through יבום, the נכרית, his original wife, became her צרה. When he dies, both fall to the last brother, who is married to the other sister. The sister is forbidden to him as אחות אשה, and the נכרית is exempt as the צרה of an ערוה. With only מאמר, which is not a full marriage, the נכרית is in a middle position, so she needs חליצה but cannot do יבום.

steps.confusionAlert: Here נכרית does NOT mean a non-Jewish woman. It just means a wife who is not related to the other wives.

steps.title: Inference: without מאמר the unrelated woman could do יבום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא reads the משנה closely. Only because there was מאמר is the נכרית limited to חליצה. Without מאמר, she could even do יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: The reason is that he did מאמר with her. But if he had not done מאמר with her, the unrelated woman could even do יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא draws an inference (a דיוק) from the משנה's words. This sets up רב נחמן's lesson in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The case here is that the sister fell to the נכרית's husband for יבום, but he died before doing anything. The only bond between them was זיקה. Since the משנה restricts the נכרית only when there was מאמר, we learn that זיקה alone does not make the נכרית a צרה of the sister.

keyTerms.meaning: The Talmud's discussion on the משנה
The reason is
But if not; introduces the opposite case that we infer

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Reads a hidden rule out of the last clause of the משנה

steps.title: רב נחמן: the levirate bond is not a real marriage, even with one brother
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן concludes from this inference that אין זיקה: the bond of a יבמה to her יבם does not count as marriage. This holds even when only one brother is involved.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב נחמן said: This tells us that זיקה is not a real bond, and that is true even with just one brother.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן states the general principle that comes out of the inference in the previous step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If זיקה made the sister like the brother's wife, the נכרית would already be her צרה, and she could not do יבום. Since the משנה implies she can, זיקה must not count as marriage. The words "even with one brother" add something: here the widow fell only to the נכרית's husband, because the other brother was her own sister's husband, so the bond was strong and focused, yet it still does not count.

keyTerms.meaning: The levirate bond between a widow and her husband's brother before יבום
The bond is not considered a real marriage
This teaches us; draws a general rule from a source
A single brother

steps.whatToRemember: From the first משנה, רב נחמן learns that זיקה alone does not make a יבמה count as the יבם's wife, even when she is bound to only one brother.
steps.whyThisMatters: Whether יש זיקה or אין זיקה is a major question across מסכת יבמות. Here רב נחמן finds a source for אין זיקה even in its strongest form, with one brother.

steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: אין זיקה, even when the bond is with a single brother.

steps.title: Second משנה: a sister's husband takes the unrelated woman
steps.stepSummary: This is the reverse case. The נכרית's husband dies, and a sister's husband does יבום with her and then dies. Again, both women go free from the last brother. With only מאמר, the נכרית does חליצה and not יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: Three brothers: two are married to two sisters, and one is married to an unrelated woman. The one married to the unrelated woman died. One of the sisters' husbands took his wife and then died. The first goes free as a wife's sister, and the second as her co-wife. If he only did מאמר with her and died, the unrelated woman does חליצה and not יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the mirror image of the first case: this time the נכרית joins the household of a man married to one of the sisters.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now the brother who dies leaves two wives: his own wife, a sister, and the נכרית he took in יבום. To the last brother, the sister is אחות אשה, and the נכרית is her צרה. The rule matches the first משנה, including the מאמר case.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: In the reverse order, both women are again exempt. With only מאמר, the נכרית does חליצה and not יבום.

steps.title: Why do we need the second משנה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the second משנה is needed, since it is the same as the first.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why do I need this one too? It is the same as the earlier one!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the second משנה as repeating what we already know. The next step explains why the second case is so obvious.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה is not supposed to teach something twice. If the second case follows from the first, it seems to add nothing new.

steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The second משנה seems to say nothing beyond the first, so it looks unnecessary.

steps.title: The קל וחומר: the second case follows even more strongly
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא backs up its question with a קל וחומר. In the first case, the forbidden sister joined the נכרית's household, and the נכרית was still forbidden. So when the נכרית joins the sister's household, she should certainly be forbidden.
steps.simpleTranslation: Think about it: there, where the wife's sister became a co-wife to the unrelated woman, you said the unrelated woman is forbidden. Here, where the unrelated woman became a co-wife to the wife's sister, isn't it all the more so?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the second משנה looks obvious: it can be learned by קל וחומר from the first.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the first משנה, the נכרית was married first, and the sister came in later. Even so, the נכרית became a צרה of the ערוה. In the second משנה, the sister was there first and the נכרית joined her, which is an even more natural way to be her צרה. So the second ruling should follow automatically.

steps.title: The תנא changed his mind about the first case
steps.stepSummary: The תנא first taught the second case. At first he permitted in the first case, and later he decided to forbid there too.
steps.simpleTranslation: The תנא taught this case first. In that other case, he at first thought she was permitted and permitted her. Later he changed his mind and forbade her.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins to answer why the second משנה is needed. It explains how the two משניות came to be.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The second משנה was written first, when the תנא still held that the first case was permitted. Back then, the second משנה taught something new. Later the תנא decided the first case is also forbidden. From then on, the second משנה could be learned from the first by a קל וחומר.

steps.title: The new ruling was placed first, and the old משנה stayed
steps.stepSummary: Because the new ruling was dear to the תנא, he put it first. The older משנה was left in its place.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since it was dear to him, he put it earlier. And a משנה does not move from its place.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its answer. It explains why the new ruling comes first and why the extra משנה was never removed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The new ruling was a fresh idea, so the תנא placed it first. The older משנה was no longer needed, but once a משנה has been fixed and taught, it is not taken out. That is why the extra משנה is still there.

steps.confusionAlert: The second משנה is not wrong. Its ruling is still true. It is simply no longer needed, since a קל וחומר teaches it.

steps.title: A sister forbidden for one moment stays forbidden forever
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה: a sister who was forbidden to a brother when she first fell to יבום stays forbidden to him forever, even after his wife dies.
steps.simpleTranslation: Three brothers: two are married to two sisters, and one is married to an unrelated woman. One of the sisters' husbands dies, and the brother married to the unrelated woman does יבום with his widow. Then the second brother's wife dies. Afterward the brother married to the unrelated woman dies. The sister is forbidden to the remaining brother forever, since she was forbidden to him at one time.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה opens with a new case. Its rule is that a woman forbidden at one moment stays forbidden.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the first sister fell to יבום, the second brother could not marry her, because she was his wife's sister. Later his wife died, and normally a wife's sister is permitted after the wife's death. Still, the משנה rules she stays forbidden forever, because she was forbidden to him at the moment of falling.

steps.whyThisMatters: It sets up the general rule that whether a יבמה is permitted depends on the moment she first falls to the brother.

steps.title: רב's rule: judge her status at the moment she falls
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה quotes רב: any יבמה to whom the פסוק of יבום cannot apply at the time she falls is like a brother's wife who has children, and she is forbidden.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יהודה said in the name of רב: Any יבמה about whom I cannot read 'Her brother-in-law shall come to her' at the time she falls to him is like the wife of a brother who has children, and she is forbidden.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings רב's general rule, which explains the משנה we just read.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If יבום could not apply at the moment she fell, the brother never had a מצוה of יבום with her. Without that מצוה, she is simply his brother's wife, which is a forbidden relationship. It is like a widow whose husband left children, who may never marry his brother.

steps.title: What does רב add beyond the משנה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what רב teaches, since the משנה already says she is forbidden forever because she was forbidden at one time.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is he teaching us? We already learned it: she is forbidden to him forever, since she was forbidden to him at one time!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רב's statement as seemingly unnecessary. This sets up an answer that will show what רב adds.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה already rules that a woman forbidden at the moment of falling stays forbidden forever. That is exactly what רב said, so his statement seems to add nothing.

steps.title: רב covers a woman who was fit for a short time
steps.stepSummary: רב is needed for the case where she was fit for יבום for a short time during the first falling. Otherwise we might say she becomes permitted.
steps.simpleTranslation: You might have said: this rule only applies where she was never fit for him during the first falling. But where she was fit for him at some point during the first falling, say she should be permitted. So רב teaches us that she is still forbidden.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question from step 11. רב adds a case the משנה does not clearly cover.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, the woman was forbidden the whole time of her first falling. רב adds a case where she was fit for a short time, for example when his wife died before the other brother did יבום. We might think that short time of being fit makes her permitted later, so רב teaches that she is still forbidden.

steps.simpleTranslation: We already learned this too: two brothers are married to two sisters. One brother died, and afterward the second brother's wife died. The widow is forbidden to him forever, since she was forbidden to him for one moment.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer in step 12. Another משנה already teaches that a short-term permission does not help.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this משנה, she was forbidden when she fell to יבום, and then right after that his wife died and she became fit. That is exactly the case of being forbidden at the start and fit later. If so, what does רב add?

keyTerms.meaning: This too we have learned: a challenge that the teaching is already known
Forever
Since, because
One moment, for a short time

phrases.english: This too we have learned:
phrases.notes: This is a משנה that comes a little later in the פרק (32a).

phrases.english: Two brothers married to two sisters,
one of them died,

phrases.aramaic: וְאַחַר כָּךְ מֵתָה אִשְׁתּוֹ שֶׁל שֵׁנִי
phrases.english: and afterward the wife of the second one died
she is forbidden to him forever,
since she was forbidden to him for one moment!

steps.triggerLanguage: הָא נָמֵי תְּנֵינָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the answer of step 12 by showing another משנה already covers that case.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim in step 12 that רב is needed for a woman who was fit for a short time
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The later משנה already says that being forbidden for one moment makes her forbidden forever, even though she became fit afterward.

steps.title: In רב's case another brother is still available
steps.stepSummary: In the other משנה, she was pushed out of the family's יבום completely. In רב's case, another brother can still do יבום, so we might have permitted her. That is why רב is needed.
steps.simpleTranslation: You might have said: there she was pushed out of this household completely. But here, she was not pushed out of this household completely. So say: since she is fit for this brother who is married to an unrelated woman, she is also fit for this brother. So רב teaches us that she is still forbidden.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge from step 13. It shows that the other משנה is a weaker case than רב's.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the later משנה, only one brother was left, and she was forbidden to him. So she was pushed out of יבום in this family completely. In רב's case, there is still a brother married to an unrelated woman who can do יבום, so we might think she is fit for the other brother too. רב teaches that she is forbidden anyway.

keyTerms.meaning: She was pushed away or pushed out
The household: here, the family's whole יבום connection
Completely
Since: because something is true in one way, it should be true in another way too

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that רב's rule is broad. Once a woman is forbidden to a brother when she falls to יבום, she stays forbidden to him, even if other brothers can still do יבום.

phrases.english: You might have said:
there is where she was pushed away
from this household completely,
but here, where she was not pushed away
from this household completely,
say: since she is fit
for this one who is married to an unrelated woman,
phrases.notes: נׇכְרִית here does not mean a non-Jew. It just means a woman who is not related to her.

phrases.english: she is also fit for this one
so he teaches us.

steps.whatToRemember: רב's rule goes further than the later משנה. Even if another brother can still do יבום, a woman who was forbidden to this brother when she fell stays forbidden to him forever.
steps.triggerLanguage: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא: הָתָם הוּא דְּאִידְּחַי לַהּ מֵהַאי בֵּיתָא לִגְמָרֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 13 by showing a difference between the two cases.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Shows the two cases are different (pushed out completely or not)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since she is fit for the brother married to an unrelated woman, she is also fit for the brother whose wife died.
steps.terutzMaskana: She is forbidden forever, even though she was not pushed out of the family's יבום completely.

steps.title: New משנה: three brothers, and the rival wife is permitted
steps.stepSummary: Three brothers: two are married to sisters and one to an unrelated woman. Events happen in a set order, and the משנה says this is the case of 'their rival wives are permitted.'
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: There are three brothers. Two of them are married to two sisters, and one is married to an unrelated woman. One of the sisters' husbands divorced his wife. Then the brother married to the unrelated woman died, and the brother who divorced did יבום with her and then died. This is what they meant when they said: 'And all of them who died or were divorced, their rival wives are permitted.'
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It explains which case is meant by a line in the opening משנה of the מסכתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The brother divorced his wife before the brother married to the unrelated woman died. So when she fell to יבום, she was never linked to a man married to the sister of the third brother's wife, and she never became that sister's צרה. When the divorcing brother dies, she falls to the third brother as a plain widow, and he may do יבום with her. The order of events is what makes her permitted.

keyTerms.meaning: משנה: a new משנה begins here
An unrelated woman (not a non-Jew)
The one who divorced
Rival wives: other wives of the same husband
Permitted

steps.confusionAlert: Be careful: the יבמה here is the unrelated woman, not either sister. She is permitted because the sister was already divorced before the unrelated woman's husband died and she fell to יבום.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
Three brothers,
two of them are married to two sisters,
and one is married to an unrelated woman.

phrases.aramaic: גֵּירַשׁ אֶחָד מִבַּעֲלֵי אֲחָיוֹת אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ,
phrases.english: One of the sisters' husbands divorced his wife,
and the one married to the unrelated woman died,
and the one who divorced married her and died
This is what they said:
And all of them who died or were divorced
phrases.notes: This quotes the opening משנה of the מסכתא about the fifteen forbidden relatives.

phrases.english: their rival wives are permitted.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁלֹשָׁה אַחִים, שְׁנַיִם מֵהֶם נְשׂוּאִין שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה after the discussion of רב's rule ends.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If the sister was divorced before the unrelated woman's husband died, that widow later falls to the third brother as a permitted woman. This is the case of 'all who died or were divorced, their rival wives are permitted.'

steps.title: The גמרא infers: order of events matters
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא reads the משנה closely. She is permitted only because the brother divorced his wife before the other brother died. If the death came first, she would be forbidden.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: The reason she is permitted is that he divorced first and only afterward the brother died. But if the brother died first and only afterward he divorced, she is forbidden.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens its discussion of the משנה by noticing the exact order of events in it. It is setting up a new idea that רב אשי will draw out in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The unrelated woman fell to two brothers for יבום. If one of them was still married to his wife (the sister of the other brother's wife) at the moment she fell, the bond of יבום would link her to him. That link would make her count as the 'rival wife' (צרה) of his wife, who is a forbidden relative (ערוה) for the remaining brother. Because the divorce came first, no such link was ever formed, so she stays permitted.

keyTerms.meaning: The reason. Used here to show that the ruling depends on one specific detail.
He divorced
She is forbidden (to the remaining brother)
The discussion of the משנה begins here

phrases.english: GEMARA:
The reason is that he divorced, and afterward [the brother] died,
phrases.notes: The one who divorced is the brother married to one of the sisters; the one who died is the brother married to the unrelated woman.

phrases.english: but if [the brother] died and afterward he divorced —
she is forbidden.

steps.triggerLanguage: טַעְמָא דְּגֵירַשׁ וְאַחַר כָּךְ מֵת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Reads the case of the משנה quoted in step 15 closely and draws an inference from the order of events in it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The woman is permitted only because the divorce came before the death. If the death had come first, she would be forbidden.

steps.title: רב אשי: the bond of יבום is real even with two brothers
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי concludes from the inference in step 16 that זיקה is real even when two brothers could do יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: This teaches that there is זיקה, even with two brothers.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי draws a general rule from the inference in step 16. The bond of יבום (זיקה) is strong enough to matter even when there are two brothers she could marry.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Why would 'died first' make her forbidden? Only if the bond of יבום already tied her to the brother who was still married to the sister. That bond would make her count as his wife's צרה. Since the bond had this effect even though two brothers could do יבום, זיקה must be real even in that case.

keyTerms.meaning: This teaches. A formula for drawing a rule out of a source.
The bond of יבום that ties a widow to her late husband's brothers
The bond is real and has legal effect
Two brothers

steps.whyThisMatters: Whether זיקה is real is a major question running through this מסכת. רב אשי takes the strongest position: the bond is real even when two brothers could do יבום.

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said:
This teaches:
there is a levirate bond,
even with two brothers.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי זֹאת אוֹמֶרֶת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns the inference of step 16 into a general rule about זיקה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: זיקה is real, even when two brothers could do יבום.

steps.title: רב אשי seems to clash with רב נחמן
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges רב אשי. רב נחמן had learned from an earlier משנה that there is no זיקה, so how can רב אשי say there is?
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to רב אשי, what רב נחמן said is difficult!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out a conflict. רב אשי says זיקה is real, but רב נחמן had proved from a משנה that it is not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier, רב נחמן read a משנה about a brother who did מאמר. He learned from it that only the מאמר made her forbidden, which means זיקה alone is not real, even with just one brother. רב אשי now says זיקה is real even with two brothers. That seems to go directly against רב נחמן's proof.

keyTerms.meaning: It is difficult. A challenge.
An אמורא who had learned from a משנה that זיקה is not real

phrases.english: And according to Rav Ashi,
what Rav Naḥman said is difficult!

steps.triggerLanguage: וּלְרַב אָשֵׁי קַשְׁיָא דְּרַב נַחְמָן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רב אשי's rule from step 17.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב אשי's rule that זיקה is real even with two brothers.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רב נחמן proved from an earlier משנה that זיקה is not real even with one brother. That contradicts רב אשי.

steps.title: רב אשי: same law even without מאמר
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי answers that in the earlier משנה, the unrelated woman would need חליצה and could not have יבום even if no מאמר was done. So that משנה proves nothing against זיקה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי can tell you: The same law applies even if he did not do מאמר with her. The unrelated woman does חליצה but may not have יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי takes away רב נחמן's proof. He says the earlier משנה's ruling does not depend on the מאמר at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב נחמן assumed that only the מאמר made her forbidden. רב אשי says that even without מאמר, the זיקה alone links her to his wife's sister, so she still cannot have יבום. That fits his view that זיקה is real. This raises a question: if so, why does that משנה mention מאמר at all? The next step answers it.

keyTerms.meaning: The same law applies
A kind of rabbinic betrothal a brother does with a יבמה before יבום
The unrelated woman (not a relative of the brothers' wives)
She does חליצה, the ceremony that releases her from יבום
She has יבום done with her

phrases.english: Rav Ashi can say to you:
the same law applies

phrases.aramaic: דְּאַף עַל גַּב דְּלָא עֲבַד בַּהּ מַאֲמָר —
phrases.english: even though he did not do levirate betrothal with her —
the unrelated woman does ḥalitza,
she does not have levirate marriage.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָךְ רַב אָשֵׁי הוּא הַדִּין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 18 by reading the earlier משנה differently.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rejects the inference behind רב נחמן's proof: the detail in the משנה is not the cause of the ruling.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since the משנה mentions מאמר, the ruling must depend on it, which would mean זיקה alone does nothing.
steps.terutzMaskana: Even without מאמר she does חליצה and not יבום, because זיקה is real.

steps.title: Why the משנה mentions מאמר: to reject בית שמאי
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי explains that the משנה mentions מאמר only to reject בית שמאי, who hold that מאמר fully acquires the יבמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the reason it teaches מאמר is to exclude the view of בית שמאי, who say: מאמר acquires.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי finishes his answer. He explains why the משנה bothered to mention מאמר if the law is the same without it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: בית שמאי hold that מאמר acquires the יבמה like a full marriage. By ruling that even after מאמר she still does חליצה, the משנה shows that מאמר does not fully acquire her. So the mention of מאמר is there to reject בית שמאי, not to teach that זיקה is unreal.

keyTerms.meaning: To exclude (a different view)
The school of שמאי
מאמר acquires (her as a full wife)

steps.whatToRemember: רב אשי: זיקה is real even with two brothers. The משנה's mention of מאמר does not prove otherwise. It is there only to reject בית שמאי's view that מאמר fully acquires.
steps.confusionAlert: רב אשי does not say מאמר does nothing. He says that in this משנה, the ruling would be the same even without it.

phrases.english: And that it teaches levirate betrothal —
is to exclude Beit Shammai,
who say: levirate betrothal acquires
phrases.notes: בית שמאי hold that מאמר makes her his full wife. The sentence finishes on the next amud.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא דְּקָתָנֵי מַאֲמָר לְאַפּוֹקֵי בֵּית שַׁמַּאי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes רב אשי's answer by explaining why the משנה mentions מאמר.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explains the extra detail in the משנה as aimed against another opinion.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The mention of מאמר shows the ruling depends on it.
steps.terutzMaskana: The mention of מאמר is there only to reject בית שמאי's view that מאמר fully acquires.
